comments.x: What worked well The advisory support provided by the Centre of Excellence (CoE) on both the PPF and the CN was particularly valuable. The comprehensive and timely revisions allowed the team to respond quickly to emerging requirements and continuously improve the quality and strategic positioning of both the CN and the PPF. A big thank you to the team, especially Germanos (Jerry), Sacha, and Jorge, for their continuous support and valuable inputs throughout the process. What could be improved The process could have benefited from earlier alignment on the overall GCF approach and a clearer sequencing of consultations. Several stakeholders became involved at different stages, bringing valuable new perspectives, insights, and alternative ways forward. While these contributions strengthened the overall thinking and helped improve the final approach, they also resulted in significant changes to the proposed direction during the process. The recently submitted guidance should definitely help address this going forward, by providing a clearer framework and enabling earlier alignment on the overall approach before progressing into more detailed development.
comments.p: Technical expertise and quality; Timeliness and responsiveness; Programme impact and usefulness; Global and regional learning

comments.x: The technical assistance provided for the development and deployment of the HOPE system was highly valuable. The support team demonstrated strong technical expertise and responsiveness throughout the process, helping to customize the system to meet the operational requirements for polio campaign payments. Regular engagement, timely troubleshooting, and hands-on guidance facilitated smooth system deployment and user adoption. A key area for improvement is the gradual transfer of skills and system ownership to the local T4D team. This can be achieved through structured hands-on training, mentorship, and periodic refresher sessions to strengthen the team's capacity for overall system administration, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Building local expertise will help ensure sustainable management of the HOPE system, reduce reliance on external support, and enhance the country's ability to independently support future polio payment operations
comments.p: Technical expertise and quality; Timeliness and responsiveness; Collaboration and communication; Programme impact and usefulness
